name: exp015-pythia-50k
desc: THE QUEUED PYTHIA-50K RUN (on the shared surface since 2026-09-20). Pythia-70M-shape trunk (6L x 512 x 8H, 'pythia' preset = 70.65M @ 50k vocab untied, 19.14M trunk) on the full re-encoded OWT 50k stream (8,882,721,400 tokens). LR 1.5e-3 = winner of the 2026-09-22 50k LR ladder (val bpb @1000 steps: 1e-3=1.7406, 1.5e-3=1.6953, 2e-3=1.7466, 3e-3=2.5025 diverged). Eff batch 64 (16x4) matches the ladder so the LR transfers. 20k-step ceiling with exp014's guard set so it self-aborts at the knee. On completion the watchdog chains to the pythia160 LR probe rung 1of3.
notes: PRECONDITION verified 2026-09-21: data/openwebtext_combined_bpe_owt50kv2.bin verify 7/7 (50k bin encoded with hf_bpe_shim for token parity; the legacy --tokenizer is vocab/bytes-per-token only). Watchdog relaunches now RESUME from the newest step ckpt (train_watchdog.newest_step_ckpt, mtime-floored at this spec). Expected duration ~7-8h at 46-72k tok/s if the knee does not fire earlier (20k steps x eff64 x 512 = 655M tokens). NOTE the '--preset pythia ' needle carries a trailing space on purpose so it cannot match a '--preset pythia160' process.
